findings.title: Tailwind CSS JIT CDN compiler requires 'unsafe-eval' in Content Security Policy
findings.description: The staging frontend relies on cdn.tailwindcss.com JIT compiler, which dynamically generates utility classes and requires 'unsafe-eval' in the script-src directive. While mitigated by strict connect-src 'self' and frame-ancestors 'none', production GA requires static pre-compiled CSS to allow removing 'unsafe-eval'.
findings.mitigationInPlace: connect-src locked to 'self', object-src 'none', frameguard 'deny', all user strings rendered via textContent.
findings.gaRequirement: Pre-compile Tailwind CSS via build step prior to EXT-001 closure and GA promotion.

findings.title: Private staging mesh operates over HTTP on Tailscale IP
findings.description: Staging server is accessed via http://100.100.25.15:4001. Network transport is encrypted at Layer 3 via WireGuard/Tailscale mesh, but application layer TLS termination and HSTS are disabled to prevent redirection loops.
findings.mitigationInPlace: Traffic restricted to authenticated mesh network peers; production deployment requires public TLS reverse proxy.
findings.gaRequirement: Implement AWS ALB TLS termination with ACM certificate under CLOUD-001.

findings.title: General Availability promotion blocked by four mandatory external dependencies
findings.description: System cannot be promoted to General Availability without closing EXT-001 (third-party penetration test), CLOUD-001 (production AWS IaC), SOAK-001 (72-hour soak test), and LEG-001 (external legal counsel briefing).
findings.mitigationInPlace: System remains strictly in Controlled Pilot / Production-Canary mode with zero live platform mutations, dry-run billing, and operational kill switch.
findings.gaRequirement: Complete all four external assurance packages detailed in EXTERNAL_ASSURANCE_PREP.md.
